title: Recent files
description:
Keep a "recent files" menu: newest first, no duplicates, at most 8.

```
open a, b, c -> c b a
open a again  -> a c b
open 9 more   -> only the 8 newest kept
a missing file is removed when chosen
```
hints: Find an equal entry with `std::find_if` and a case-insensitive comparison, erase it, then insert at the beginning (lesson 4.01).
requirements: `add(path)` moves an existing entry to the front, or inserts it there.
Paths compare without caring about case (they are Windows paths).
Save and load the list as lines of text.
stretch: Show only the file name in the menu but the full path in a tooltip.
